actions: Create and open this dedicated new part using the verified default part template.
Create Reference sketch on XY: circle center (10,20) mm, radius 10 mm; open polyline (50,0),(60,10),(70,0) mm.
In the same batch create Parabola sketch on XY: vertex (-30,-20) mm, focal length 12.5 mm, x range -20 to 20 mm, rotation 0 degrees.
Create Linked sketch with a native associative reference to Reference sketch's circle-center vertex and sketch axes; offset (20,30,0) mm, rotation 90 degrees; local circle radius 2.5 mm.
Translate only Reference sketch by (10,0,0) mm; read back Linked sketch and verify that its origin follows by 10 mm.
Keep the dedicated test part open for review. Do not save, check in, delete or modify any pre-existing document. Stop after any failure; keep receipts.
permission: Requires explicit user approval of this exact test plan. Supplying a hash is not authorization by itself.
